# MCP Tool Descriptions

<!-- Auto-generated by `npm run generate:stub-catalog` from the server's tools/list — do not edit. -->

The first sentence of each tool's description, as `tools/list` gives it on Windows (30 tools, plus
`desktop_discover` and `desktop_act`, which the v2 module registers at run time). The full descriptions and
argument schemas are in `src/stub-tool-catalog.ts`.

| Tool | Description |
|---|---|
| `browser_click` | Click a DOM element in Chrome/Edge. |
| `browser_eval` | Inspect or operate on a browser tab via 3 actions: 'js' (evaluate JS), 'dom' (get HTML), 'appState' (extract SSR-injected SPA state). |
| `browser_fill` | Fill a form input with a value via CDP — works on React/Vue/Svelte controlled inputs that reject browser_eval value assignment. |
| `browser_form` | Inspect all form fields (input, select, textarea, button) within a CSS-selector-specified container and return their name, type, id, current value (withheld for a field the page masks, such as a password: value is null,… |
| `browser_locate` | Find a DOM element by CSS selector and return its physical screen coordinates — compatible directly with mouse_click. |
| `browser_navigate` | Navigate a browser tab to a URL via CDP Page.navigate — more reliable than clicking the address bar. |
| `browser_open` | Connect to Chrome/Edge running with --remote-debugging-port and return open tab IDs — required before all other browser_* tools. |
| `browser_overview` | List all interactive elements (links, buttons, inputs, ARIA controls) on the current page with CSS selectors, visible text (an input's name — never what is typed in it), and viewport status — use before browser_click to… |
| `browser_search` | Grep-like element search across the current page. |
| `click_element` | Invoke a UI element by name or automationId via UIA InvokePattern — no screen coordinates needed. |
| `clipboard` | Read or write the Windows clipboard. |
| `desktop_state` | Read-only observation of the current desktop state. |
| `excel` | Author and run VBA macros against Excel via COM late binding (ADR-015). |
| `focus_window` | Bring a window to the foreground by partial title match (case-insensitive), or exactly by hwnd (from desktop_discover's windows[].hwnd, or a refusal's suggest). |
| `key_locker` | Manage credentials the terminal autofills for you (SSH key passphrases, sudo / login passwords). |
| `keyboard` | Send keyboard input to a window: 'type' for text, 'press' for key combos, 'sequence' for atomic multi-step chords. |
| `mouse_click` | Click at screen coordinates. |
| `mouse_drag` | Click and drag from (startX, startY) to (endX, endY) holding the left mouse button — for sliders, drag-and-drop, canvas drawing, and window resizing. |
| `notification_show` | Show a Windows system tray balloon notification to alert the user. |
| `run_macro` | Execute multiple tools sequentially in one MCP call — eliminates round-trip latency for predictable multi-step workflows. |
| `screenshot` | Capture desktop, window, or region across detail levels (meta / text / image / som / ocr) and capture modes (normal / background). |
| `screenshot_gc` | Reclaim disk space from cached screenshots by retention policy. |
| `screenshot_query` | List screenshots already saved in the disk-cache WITHOUT re-reading any pixels. |
| `scroll` | Scroll a window or page. |
| `server_status` | Return MCP server status. |
| `terminal` | Interact with a terminal window: read output, send input, or run+wait+read in one call. |
| `wait_until` | Server-side poll for an observable condition — eliminates screenshot-polling loops when waiting for state changes. |
| `window_dock` | Decorate a window: pin (always-on-top), unpin, or dock (move + resize + optional pin). |
| `workspace_launch` | Launch an application and wait for its window to appear, returning the window's title, HWND, and PID. |
| `workspace_snapshot` | Orient fully in one call — returns display layouts, all window thumbnails (WebP), and per-window actionable element lists with clickAt coords. |
